result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **I'd recommend Stripe as the best overall payment processor**, unless you're already using Shopify, in which case Shopify Payments is usually the better choice.

The best option depends on your ecommerce platform, transaction volume, and how customers prefer to pay.

## Top 5 payment processors

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Typical US online card fee: 2.9% + \$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee
- Excellent ecommerce integrations
- Supports subscriptions, international payments, and digital wallets

Best for: Independent online stores, WooCommerce, and custom websites.

[Stripe website](https://stripe.com)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Typical starting online card fee: 2.9% + \$0.30
- Integrated directly into Shopify
- Simplifies refunds and order management
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees imposed by Shopify

Best for: Stores already running on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments website](https://www.shopify.com/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- PayPal Checkout commonly charges 3.49% + \$0.49
- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers
- Supports PayPal and other payment options
- Easy to add to most ecommerce platforms

Best for: Giving customers another trusted checkout option.

[PayPal Business website](https://www.paypal.com/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Online fees around 3.3% + \$0.30 on its Free plan
- Easy setup
- Integrates online and in-person sales
- Inventory and point-of-sale tools

Best for: Businesses selling online and at physical locations.

[Square website](https://squareup.com/us/en/payments)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Interchange-plus pricing
- No standard monthly fee
- Potential savings as transaction volume grows
- More detailed payment cost structure

Best for: Growing businesses processing higher volumes.

[Helcim website](https://www.helcim.com)

|--------|--------|
